messages:
maya: hey — tried to accept the GitHub org invite but I get 'Accept requires SSO and 2FA' and my YubiKey flow errors out with "MFA device not recognized". the invite email looks like maya+redwood@gmail.com (i use +aliases). can someone re-send or fix? first day jitters :sweat_smile:

invite-bot: Your invitation to Redwood Inference (maya+redwood@gmail.com) is still pending. Invite expires in 6 days.

jeff (people-ops): @maya welcome! can you try accepting in an incognito window and ensure you're logged into the work email (not personal)? also check https://github.com/settings/security if your YubiKey is registered there.

maya: tried incognito and logged into maya@redwood.co but the invite link still redirects to personal account. looks like github tied the token to the alias. i cannot add yubikey because it asks for the org SSO first.

sam (infra): @jeff @lina sounds like we should re-issue the invite to the canonical work email. jeff — can you re-send to maya@redwood.co and tick 'require SSO'? i'll manually add to the 'platform' team once accepted. if still broken, we can make her a direct member and move teams later.

jeff (people-ops): re-sent invite to maya@redwood.co with SSO required. msg: "Resent by jeff — accepts work email only". maya, you should get it in a minute. if it times out I'll create a temporary org membership and we can sync teams.

lina (eng-manager): welcome @maya :wave: once you're in I'll add you to eng-platform and grant repo write to infra-config and service-runtime. shout if you need early access to dev sandbox.

maya: got it — accepted via work email, yubikey registration worked after SSO redirect. thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
